title: EVERYTHING MUST PASS THROUGH THE FIRE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood." Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, "This is what is required by the law that the Lord gave Moses: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water." - Num 31:20-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After the battle came the cleansing. Nothing could simply be brought into the camp as it was. Metal had to pass through fire; everything else had to pass through the water of cleansing. God was teaching His people that even the spoils of a God-commanded victory carried defilement that had to be dealt with. Holiness was not optional.

There is a beautiful principle tucked into these ceremonial details. Fire and water were both instruments of cleansing — and Scripture often uses fire as a picture of God refining His people. Peter says our faith is tested by trials the way gold is tested by fire, so that it may prove genuine (1 Pet 1:7). The things we pass through are not always comfortable, but in God's hands they purify rather than destroy.

We should not read these ceremonial laws as binding rules for believers today; they were shadows fulfilled in Christ (Col 2:16-17). But the heart behind them still stands: God cares about purity, and He is committed to making His people clean. The wonderful difference now is that our cleansing does not depend on our efforts with fire and water. It is Jesus who purifies us, washing us thoroughly and presenting us holy before God (Eph 5:26-27).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What "fire" are you passing through, and how might God be refining you in it?
2. Do you treat holiness as optional or essential?
3. How does it comfort you that Christ Himself makes you clean?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Refining Lord, thank You that even the trials I pass through are in Your hands for my good. Purify my heart, and thank You that Jesus has washed me clean. Amen.
